name: Who Is Going To Heaven
overview: Scripture reveals that entrance into heaven is not guaranteed by mere profession of faith but requires doing the will of God the Father, as Jesus teaches in Matthew 7:21. True access to the kingdom of heaven comes through being born again, a spiritual rebirth emphasized in John 3:3, and believing in Jesus Christ, God's only begotten Son, who alone has ascended from heaven (John 3:13). The promise of everlasting life is extended to those who hear Jesus' word and believe in the One who sent Him, passing from death to life and escaping condemnation (John 5:24). Ultimately, the Son of Man will return in glory to judge and establish His kingdom (Matthew 25:31), affirming that salvation and heaven belong to those who trust in Christ and live according to God's will.
